results.text: Day five is where I get stuck. If I started dissociating then, I wouldn’t know what the instruction wants me to do with that. Is it a warning, or am I supposed to sit there and observe the warning too? There are plenty of “dark night” stories on r/vipassana. Critics talk about a “push through” culture. Some teachers compare intense practice without emotional groundwork to revving an engine without oil.
